title: Gold in your iPhone: every upgrade, you throw away real gold
format: Treasure/curiosity format test (not a threat story), HSERIA + CTA, second person, rule book v8 (format A), 4 character beats
voice: Kokoro af_heart (voice B); presets sped up for #16 (short, choppy sentences read slow at #15's presets)

lines.text: Every time you upgrade your iPhone, you throw away real gold.
lines.spoken: Every time you upgrade your iPhone, you throw away real gold.

lines.text: Real gold. Inside your old phone.
lines.spoken: Real gold. Inside your old phone.

lines.text: Recycling plants do this. Don't try it at home.
lines.spoken: Recycling plants do this. Don't try it at home.

lines.text: It only takes three simple steps.
lines.spoken: It only takes three simple steps.

lines.text: First, the battery comes out. Very, very important.
lines.spoken: First, the battery comes out. Very, very important.

lines.text: If it gets crushed or punctured, it can catch fire.
lines.spoken: If it gets crushed or punctured, it can catch fire.

lines.text: These shiny pins? Gold.
lines.spoken: These shiny pins? Gold.

lines.text: Some chips have gold wires thinner than a hair.
lines.spoken: Some chips have gold wires thinner than a hair.

lines.text: The board goes in a liquid. Slowly, slowly, it turns blue.
lines.spoken: The board goes in a liquid. Slowly, slowly, it turns blue.

lines.text: It falls apart into ugly mud.
lines.spoken: It falls apart into ugly mud.

lines.text: Once the bubbling stops, the mud starts to sparkle.
lines.spoken: Once the bubbling stops, the mud starts to sparkle.

lines.text: Wash it, rinse it, wash it again. A stronger acid turns it yellow.
lines.spoken: Wash it, rinse it, wash it again. A stronger acid turns it yellow.

lines.text: Once the bubbling stops again, brown dust falls down.
lines.spoken: Once the bubbling stops again, brown dust falls down.

lines.text: This brown dust? Pure gold. Gold sand, gold dust, whatever.
lines.spoken: This brown dust? Pure gold. Gold sand, gold dust, whatever.

lines.text: Heat it, pour it, and there it is. A real gold bar.
lines.spoken: Heat it, pour it, and there it is. A real gold bar.

lines.text: Honest part? One phone gives about three pounds of gold.
lines.spoken: Honest part? One phone gives about three pounds of gold.

lines.text: For this bar? About thirty thousand more phones.
lines.spoken: For this bar? About thirty thousand more phones.

lines.text: Tonne for tonne, old phones still beat a gold mine.
lines.spoken: Tonne for tonne, old phones still beat a gold mine.

lines.text: Erase it before you recycle. Your photos and bank apps are still inside.
lines.spoken: Erase it before you recycle. Your photos and bank apps are still inside.

lines.text: How many old phones are in your drawer? Tell me below.
lines.spoken: How many old phones are in your drawer? Tell me below.
